description: Direct event setup on the built-in bitbucket_data_center source, with the repository picked from the user's Bitbucket Data Center connection and stored as its clone URL. The create bodies validate against CreatePromptAutomationRequest in OpenHands/automation (openhands/automation/preset_router.py); the data-center-clone body's repos needs an openhands-sdk with the bitbucket_data_center repository provider (OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#6281).

scenarios.description: A picked repository and the default tone, on a service whose runs do not clone Bitbucket Data Center (its repoProviders lack bitbucket_data_center, as every service on openhands-sdk 1.59.0 or earlier). The request carries no repos: the prompt has the agent clone the repository with the owner's connection. Preflight passes, the automation is created.

draft.name: Bitbucket Data Center code review - https://bitbucket.example.com/scm/ENG/payments.git
draft.prompt:
Review the Bitbucket Data Center pull request described in the event payload below, in the repository https://bitbucket.example.com/scm/ENG/payments.git. Use a concise review tone.

1. Unless the repository is already cloned in the workspace, clone it with the Bitbucket Data Center token you receive as the bitbucket_data_center_token secret (use the bitbucket-data-center skill for authentication). Fetch the pull request head with `git fetch origin refs/pull-requests/<id>/from` and check out the payload's fromRef.latestCommit.
2. Review the changes against the target branch for correctness, security, tests and maintainability. Run focused tests when they help confirm a finding.
3. Post the review through the Bitbucket Data Center REST API: inline comments on the lines that need changes, then one summary comment that names the reviewed commit.

Only read the repository and write pull request comments: never push, approve, decline or merge. If the pull request has no reviewable changes, post a short summary comment saying so.

trigger.filter: (eventKey == 'pr:opened' || eventKey == 'pr:from_ref_updated') && pullRequest.draft != `true` && (ends_with(lower('https://bitbucket.example.com/scm/ENG/payments.git'), lower(join('', ['/scm/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.project.key, '/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.slug, '.git']))) || ends_with(lower('https://bitbucket.example.com/scm/ENG/payments.git'), lower(join('', ['/scm/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.project.key, '/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.slug]))))
